seo.title: HAPI-eVolved — Your agents. Your infrastructure. Faster evolution.
seo.description: An independent fork of HAPI for self-hosted coding agents: project workspaces, protected credentials, GitHub access, persistent memory and code graphs.

hero.title: Your agents. Your infrastructure.
hero.description: A practical workspace for coding agents, with your projects, credentials and knowledge under your control. An independent, fast-moving fork of HAPI — built for the work you want to get done.
hero.note: AGPL-3.0-only · Source installation · Desktop and mobile web

workspace.title: A place for every project
workspace.description: Automatic project folders, runner access and agent sessions.

knowledge.title: Context that carries forward
knowledge.description: Persistent memory and code relationships you can inspect.

control.title: Permissions you can manage
control.description: Passkeys, project profiles and explicit credential grants.

features.title: Useful details, connected.
features.description: Build on HAPI’s agent control with tools for everyday development. Integrations require their own setup; provider availability and permissions still apply.

projects.title: Project workspaces
projects.description: Give each project its own folder automatically, or choose a path. Manage project members, profiles and revocable runner access.

providers.title: Browser provider login
providers.description: Connect Claude or Codex through their native login flows. Inspect native model catalogs and use a model ID when needed.

vault.title: Local credential vault
vault.description: Manage encrypted secrets in the browser, with passkey-protected administration and scoped access for agents.

github.title: GitHub connections
github.description: Grant repository read or write access explicitly. Push also requires a suitable project profile, runner scope and GitHub credential.

memory.title: Persistent memory
memory.description: Keep project knowledge beyond one session. Opt in to the optional Graphiti/Neo4j service for connected memory and retrieval, with configured providers and budgets.

codegraph.title: Codegraph
codegraph.description: Inspect repository symbols and relationships through the integrated code graph. Indexes help navigate code; they do not replace tests.

extensions.title: Agents and plugins
extensions.description: Create reusable specialist profiles. Preview declarative plugins from public GitHub repositories, including skills and themes.

interface.title: Desktop and PWA
interface.description: Work from a responsive browser interface with themes, project navigation and session controls. Install the PWA on supported browsers.

setup.title: A deliberate setup. A flexible workspace.
setup.description: eVolved is a source preview for self-hosting. Follow the project quick start for the current requirements, security boundaries and deployment options.

build.title: Build the source
build.description: Clone this repository and follow the Bun build instructions. Managed runners need a Linux container environment.

configure.title: Create your workspace
configure.description: Bootstrap the hub, register a passkey and create a project. Connect the providers and repositories you need.

work.title: Run, inspect, improve
work.description: Start an agent, review its changes and retain useful knowledge. Extend the setup as your workflow develops.

setup.sourceDescription: The source repository is the distribution and documentation entry point for this preview.
setup.requirements: AI providers have separate accounts, subscriptions or API charges. Optional graph services and managed runners require additional configuration.

origins.title: A fork with a clear purpose.
origins.description: HAPI-eVolved builds on the local-first agent control created by the contributors to
origins.mission: Our direction is faster, practical feature development: connect the tools developers need, make their controls visible, and review changes before shipping.
origins.independence: This is an independently maintained project. It is not the upstream HAPI release or an official product of Anthropic, OpenAI or GitHub. The original licenses and contributor notices are retained.

footer.description: Your agents. Your infrastructure. Faster evolution. An independent fork of HAPI.
